examples.title: Action toolbar
examples.code:
import { Button, Toolbar } from '@advui/core'
import { EditIcon, PlusIcon, TrashIcon } from '@advui/icons'

export default function ToolbarBasic() {
  return (
    <Toolbar aria-label="Project actions" variant="outline">
      <Button size="sm" icon={<PlusIcon />}>
        New
      </Button>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" icon={<EditIcon />}>
        Edit
      </Button>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" icon={<TrashIcon />}>
        Delete
      </Button>
    </Toolbar>
  )
}

examples.title: Groups and separators
examples.code:
import { Button, Toolbar } from '@advui/core'

// Text-only buttons, so the bar fits a 360pt phone.
export default function ToolbarGroups() {
  return (
    <Toolbar aria-label="Edit" variant="outline">
      <Toolbar.Group aria-label="History">
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
          Undo
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
          Redo
        </Button>
      </Toolbar.Group>
      <Toolbar.Separator />
      <Toolbar.Group aria-label="Clipboard">
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
          Copy
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
          Paste
        </Button>
      </Toolbar.Group>
    </Toolbar>
  )
}

examples.name: data-table
examples.title: Data table toolbar
examples.code:
import { Badge, Button, HStack, Heading, Input, Toolbar } from '@advui/core'
import { DownloadIcon, PlusIcon } from '@advui/icons'

export default function ToolbarDataTable() {
  return (
    <Toolbar
      aria-label="Users table"
      variant="ghost"
      width="100%"
      wrap
      leading={
        <HStack gap="2">
          <Heading level={3} size="lg">
            Users
          </Heading>
          <Badge variant="secondary">128</Badge>
        </HStack>
      }
      trailing={
        <>
          <Input size="sm" width="56" placeholder="Filter users…" aria-label="Filter users" />
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" icon={<DownloadIcon />}>
            Export
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" icon={<PlusIcon />}>
            Add user
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    />
  )
}

import { Button, IconButton, Text, Toolbar } from '@advui/core'
import { DownloadIcon, TrashIcon, XIcon } from '@advui/icons'

export default function ToolbarBulkActions() {
  return (
    <Toolbar
      aria-label="Selected rows"
      variant="filled"
      width="100%"
      size="sm"
      leading={
        <Text size="sm" paddingHorizontal="2" weight="medium">
          3 selected
        </Text>
      }
      trailing={
        <>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon={<DownloadIcon />}>
            Export
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" icon={<TrashIcon />}>
            Delete
          </Button>
          <IconButton size="sm" aria-label="Clear selection" icon={<XIcon />} />
        </>
      }
    />
  )
}

examples.name: formatting
examples.title: Formatting toolbar
examples.code:
import { IconButton, ToggleGroup, Toolbar, Tooltip } from '@advui/core'
import {
  AlignCenterIcon,
  AlignLeftIcon,
  AlignRightIcon,
  BoldIcon,
  ItalicIcon,
  LinkIcon,
  QuoteIcon,
  UnderlineIcon,
} from '@advui/icons'

// role="toolbar": one Tab stop, and the arrow keys move across every control,
// the Toggle Group items included.
export default function ToolbarFormatting() {
  return (
    <Toolbar role="toolbar" aria-label="Formatting" variant="outline" size="sm">
      <ToggleGroup type="multiple" size="sm" defaultValue={['bold']} aria-label="Text style">
        <ToggleGroup.Item value="bold" aria-label="Bold" icon={<BoldIcon />} />
        <ToggleGroup.Item value="italic" aria-label="Italic" icon={<ItalicIcon />} />
        <ToggleGroup.Item value="underline" aria-label="Underline" icon={<UnderlineIcon />} />
      </ToggleGroup>
      <Toolbar.Separator />
      <ToggleGroup type="single" size="sm" defaultValue="left" aria-label="Alignment">
        <ToggleGroup.Item value="left" aria-label="Align left" icon={<AlignLeftIcon />} />
        <ToggleGroup.Item value="center" aria-label="Align center" icon={<AlignCenterIcon />} />
        <ToggleGroup.Item value="right" aria-label="Align right" icon={<AlignRightIcon />} />
      </ToggleGroup>
      <Toolbar.Separator />
      <Toolbar.Group aria-label="Insert">
        <Tooltip content="Insert link">
          <IconButton size="sm" aria-label="Insert link" icon={<LinkIcon />} />
        </Tooltip>
        <Tooltip content="Quote">
          <IconButton size="sm" aria-label="Quote" icon={<QuoteIcon />} />
        </Tooltip>
      </Toolbar.Group>
    </Toolbar>
  )
}

examples.name: vertical
examples.title: Vertical editor toolbar
examples.code:
import { IconButton, Toolbar, Tooltip } from '@advui/core'
import { EditIcon, HeadingIcon, ImageIcon, RotateCwIcon, TrashIcon } from '@advui/icons'

const tools = [
  { label: 'Draw', icon: <EditIcon /> },
  { label: 'Text', icon: <HeadingIcon /> },
  { label: 'Image', icon: <ImageIcon /> },
  { label: 'Rotate', icon: <RotateCwIcon /> },
]

// Up and Down move between the tools.
export default function ToolbarVertical() {
  return (
    <Toolbar
      role="toolbar"
      aria-label="Canvas tools"
      orientation="vertical"
      variant="outline"
      size="sm"
    >
      {tools.map(({ label, icon }) => (
        <Tooltip key={label} content={label} side="right">
          <IconButton aria-label={label} icon={icon} />
        </Tooltip>
      ))}
      <Toolbar.Separator />
      <Tooltip content="Delete" side="right">
        <IconButton aria-label="Delete" icon={<TrashIcon />} />
      </Tooltip>
    </Toolbar>
  )
}

examples.code:
import { Button, Toolbar } from '@advui/core'
import { CheckIcon } from '@advui/icons'

// Style props win over the variant and size, whatever their order.
export default function ToolbarCustom() {
  return (
    <Toolbar
      aria-label="Draft"
      variant="outline"
      backgroundColor="card"
      borderColor="primary"
      borderRadius="full"
      paddingHorizontal="3"
      gap="1"
      alignSelf="center"
    >
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">
        Discard
      </Button>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
        Preview
      </Button>
      <Button size="sm" icon={<CheckIcon />}>
        Publish
      </Button>
    </Toolbar>
  )
}
